description: The Goals empty state tells the person to run `pardner vein create --title … --goal …`, but that command does not work for the signed-in person. With --data it fails with ACTOR_REQUIRED; with --actor it fails with LOCAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (it looks for a standalone sync server). It works only with an agent token file, or through `client operation` with a hand-written JSON payload.
expected: The hinted command works for the person in the browser (for example as `pardner client vein create …` or `--data` bound to the client identity), or the empty state offers a UI create.
actual: ACTOR_REQUIRED "Supply --actor or PARDNER_ACTOR", then LOCAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE "Could not reach sync server: fetch failed".
suggested_fix: Add a minimal New goal / New vein form on Goals, or make the hint name a command that resolves the client's own credential.

description: The only CLI route open to a person, `client operation`, authors the change as the client's Setup agent. Activity therefore reads "Setup agent started vein Cache tax rates at the edge for new goal Cut checkout latency" when Maya did it. A person can never author a goal or vein as herself.
suggested_fix: Give people a create path authored as themselves (UI form or a client CLI subcommand acting as the identity).

description: A mistyped, non-ID-shaped `--goal goal-2adcfd` silently creates a new goal titled "goal-2adcfd". The result is only hinted at by `createdGoal:true` in the JSON. The Goals view then shows a junk goal.
expected: A value that starts with `goal-` but is not a valid ID is rejected (or needs an explicit --new-goal).
actual: Goal "goal-2adcfd" created with the vein under it.
suggested_fix: Treat `goal-` prefixed values as IDs and return NOT_FOUND, or split --goal-id from --new-goal.

description: Nothing in the UI explains goals or veins. The empty state only shows a CLI command, and vein buttons have no tooltip.
expected: One line of plain-language explanation (a goal is an outcome; a vein is one approach being tried) on the empty state.
actual: "No goals yet. Start a vein with pardner vein create --title … --goal …."
suggested_fix: Add a one-sentence explanation to the empty state.

description: `vein create --description` is accepted and stored, but the Goals view never shows a vein description; goal descriptions are shown.
expected: The vein description is visible (muted line or tooltip on the vein button).
actual: "Staging runs on prod-sized instances" is not visible anywhere in the UI.
suggested_fix: Render the vein description under the vein row like the goal description.

description: The Goals empty-state text is centred across the column while the Goals heading is left-aligned at x=298.
expected: The empty state aligns with the heading's left edge, as goal rows do.
actual: The text is centred around x=720.
suggested_fix: Left-align the empty-state paragraph in the Goals view.

description: Every client registers its agent as "Setup agent", so the header shows three identical "SA" avatars and Activity shows "registered Setup agent as an agent" twice. Agents from different people cannot be told apart.
expected: Agent names distinguish their owner (for example "Dev's agent").
suggested_fix: Default the agent display name to include the owning person, or allow naming at grant time.
